The '''Quesaya system''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Andirma sector/Legends|Andirma sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Quesaya Border Conflict]] that was fought in [[4007 BBY]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> By [[3996 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated in the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]," an area that was well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quesaya system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA" />
